text: {"assertions":["A flapping flag bug in the feature flag evaluator caused decisions to alternate between calls when evaluating the same flag for a user.","The flapping flag issue only manifested for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The root cause was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) in the database.","The fix involved adding the composite index and backfilling data in batches, delivered in PR #3781 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1.","Resolving the flapping flag bug reclaimed 61 GB of blob storage.","The feature flags system is implemented in Go with covering test checks defined in platform/featureflags/eval_test.go."]}
